fresh install > health: the shared health check, its content address is the content app's, and the inventory maps both addresses to it
fresh install > isolation canary: its PAT and its test login session work there and are refused at rl-a
rl-a > health: the shared health check
rl-a > who am I: a fresh person sees the plan and exactly its features
rl-a > prod-clean: the published prod releases are the signed customer build and no prod install shows test hooks
rl-a > environments and services are kept apart: robot token audiences, staging on prod, the inventory, the OAuth metadata
rl-a > anti-bot: a code request with no Turnstile token is 400 turnstile_required
rl-a > code sign-in: a fresh person signs in by code, and every cookie is __Host-, Secure, Path=/, with no Domain
rl-a > Google sign-in start: it reaches Google with a client id, the callback address and the broker state for rl-a
rl-a > files and pages: an MCP publish is found by search, a signed upload becomes a version, one live-data value reads back
rl-a > viewing: a private view on the content address sets no cookie, a live-data socket opens, a public link stops once private
